description: Resolve one or more QIDs or PIDs to their human-readable labels and descriptions. Lightweight — returns no claim data. Supports up to 50 IDs per call (batched automatically). Designed for the common agent pattern: receive QIDs from a SPARQL query, then humanize them.

ids.description: Q-IDs (e.g., "Q76") or P-IDs (e.g., "P31") to resolve. 1–50 IDs per call.

languages.description: Wikidata language codes for returned labels and descriptions (e.g., ["en", "de", "fr"]). Case-insensitive; "_" is read as "-"; blank entries are dropped, and an empty list means ["en"]. A language with no label of its own falls back to the entity's multilingual ("mul") value, returned under the requested code.

name: wikidata_get_labels

descriptions.description: Map of language code to description string. Keys match the requested languages that have data.

labels.description: Map of language code to label string. Keys match the requested languages that have data.

entities.description: Map of entity ID to labels and descriptions. IDs that were not found are absent.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_ids`: One or more IDs in the array are not valid Q-IDs or P-IDs. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

found.description: Count of IDs that returned data.

languages.description: The language codes that were requested.

notFound.description: IDs from the request that did not return data (not found or invalid).

title: Get Wikidata Labels
